item.title: Ente Community Discord Oct 30, 2026 - 52 messages in 5 channels
item.description:
The Ente Community saw 52 messages across five active channels, with conversation concentrated in #photos. Discussions focused mainly on iOS photo organization and interface design, alongside a small Auth support thread.

#photos

With 42 messages from 12 participants, this was the busiest channel. Members discussed force-uploading, finding and removing “uncategorized” photos, possible duplicates, moving photos into albums on iOS, and image zoom behavior. There was also extended debate over Apple’s “Liquid Glass” design and whether Ente should use it for navigation.

#auth

Five messages from three participants covered Ente Auth installation on an HP Chromebook, including a sideloaded F-Droid build. The device’s webcam compatibility was discussed, and a fix was said to be expected in the next build.

#locker

Two participants discussed whether Locker is intentionally opinionated and whether its purpose is clearer as a dead man’s switch or a drive-like service.

#off-topic

Two links were shared for discussion: a GitHub project called Kensaku and a Guardian article about a Binance hack.

#memes

One participant posted an attachment.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Oct 27, 2026 - 65 messages in 6 channels
item.description:
Activity was concentrated in #photos, with discussions spanning the latest Ente Photos release, web feedback, self-hosting, device support, translations, and feature requests. Other channels saw lighter conversation about Locker’s scope, AI and Microsoft layoffs, memes, and a minor app troubleshooting update.

#photos

With 46 messages from 17 participants, this was the busiest channel. Members praised the new web design and gallery look, shared feedback, and discussed iPhone Duo support, Korean translations, image-picker improvements, face blurring, and screenshot protection for Locked Folders. Self-hosting questions covered Docker, macOS, and moving data from self-hosted Ente to the SaaS service, including a GitHub discussion and the self-hosting requirements.

#off-topic

Eight messages from three participants covered AI in the Linux kernel and reactions to a community’s anti-AI and solo-developer stance. The conversation also touched on Microsoft’s voluntary exit packages, with a news link shared.

#locker

Six messages from five participants discussed whether Locker should serve as a general cloud drive, its 1,000-item cap, and bulk export. The responses emphasized that Locker is intended for sensitive or important documents rather than everyday files; bulk export is not currently available but is believed to be on the roadmap.

#memes

Three messages shared two TikTok links and one attachment.

#announcements

A new Ente Photos release was announced, highlighting a refreshed gallery look and viewing photos in their original proportions.

#ensu

A user reported that deleting and reinstalling the app resolved an issue.
